split: official TRAIN only; fixed within-state held-question split

selection.state_identity: SHA-256 of normalized ordered evidence state; exactly one source fact-pair group per normalized state
selection.held_question: Choose one globally unique normalized question per eligible state using Python random.Random(17) over sorted state keys and sorted eligible questions; hold all rows with that question
selection.state_overlap: intentional: each held state has at least one other training question
selection.question_option_overlap: zero normalized question plus sorted option-set overlap

readout.checkpoint_rule: single final epoch-8 checkpoint; no held-question evaluation before final epoch

held_controls: zero state-content vector with the state slot present
deterministic Sattolo-deranged different-state feature with criterion present
exposure: All QASC TRAIN rows were already included in the preceding five-fold experiment universe; this is an internal development diagnostic, not an independent project-level holdout.
claim_scope: text-only same-fact-state/new-question transfer diagnostic; not multimodal, persistent-cache, broad text, or product quality
